description: This file defines the 'BeanListRequest' class, which encapsulates parameters for retrieving a list of beans in the SuiteCRM API. It provides methods to set query parameters like order, filter conditions, limits, and fields, and includes a fetch method to execute the request and obtain a response.

classes.name: BeanListRequest
classes.description: A class that represents a request for retrieving a list of beans with customizable query parameters.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the BeanListRequest with a specific SugarBean instance.

methods.name: orderBy
methods.description: Sets the order by clause for the query.

methods.name: where
methods.description: Sets the filter condition for the query.

methods.name: limit
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of records to fetch.

methods.name: max
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of records to retrieve.

methods.name: deleted
methods.description: Specifies whether to include deleted records.

methods.name: singleSelect
methods.description: Sets whether the query is for a single record selection.

methods.name: fields
methods.description: Sets the specific fields to retrieve.

methods.name: fetch
methods.description: Executes the request and returns a BeanListResponse containing the list of beans.
